data.content_ref: inline:Add an explicit second-order rule: an argument is accepted iff all its attackers are rejected, and rejected iff at least one accepted attacker exists; but with a guarded rule that also tracks 'unresolved attacker' in a three-valued logic. This reaxiomatizes the grounded extension in the style of well-founded semantics, where the grounded extension is the well-founded model. The expansion allows adding well-founded negative premises from support chains without leaving the polynomial class via alternating fixpoint. Determinism and reinstatement follow from the well-founded semantics. Criticizable: this may duplicate existing closure-rule work and requires proving equivalence with the current Pass 1 fixed point for standard frameworks.
